claims: Denny Hamlin won the NASCAR Cup Series Pennzoil 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway on March 15, 2026.
Denny Hamlin led a race-high 134 laps in the NASCAR Cup Series Pennzoil 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway on March 15, 2026.
Denny Hamlin held off Chase Elliott by 0.502 seconds in the NASCAR Cup Series Pennzoil 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway on March 15, 2026.
Denny Hamlin received an early speeding penalty in the NASCAR Cup Series Pennzoil 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway on March 15, 2026.
The victory was Denny Hamlin's 61st career win.
The victory was Denny Hamlin's first victory of the 2026 season.
The victory was Denny Hamlin's second consecutive win at the 1.5-mile track.
Denny Hamlin drove the #11 Joe Gibbs Racing Toyota in the NASCAR Cup Series Pennzoil 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway on March 15, 2026.
Denny Hamlin overcame a pit road penalty in the second stage of the NASCAR Cup Series Pennzoil 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway on March 15, 2026.
Denny Hamlin drove from the back to win the NASCAR Cup Series Pennzoil 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway on March 15, 2026.
Denny Hamlin is a team owner of 23XI Racing.
Tyler Reddick is a 23XI Racing driver.
A tragic house fire during the offseason took the life of Denny Hamlin's father.
Denny Hamlin dedicated the win to his family.
Denny Hamlin is in his 21st season with Joe Gibbs Racing.
